release: Market Core V2.0-Alpha · Build 38.15.5 · Classic Atlas Auto Manual Control
notes: Adds persistent Atlas AUTO / MANUAL operator control.
Fresh profiles default to MANUAL to prevent Atlas from starting on every page load or canonical refresh.
MANUAL blocks automatic Atlas scheduling while Market, Binance LIVE, CoinGecko, chart and Math Core continue normally.
The existing Analyse complète button still starts one complete Atlas -> NØX -> Aerith cycle in MANUAL mode.
AUTO restores the existing canonical-snapshot automation.
Build 38.15.2 Firefox end-of-cycle stability fix is preserved.
Graph code is intentionally unchanged from 38.15.2; the visible graph discontinuity remains a known unresolved defect across graph views.
